// diagnostic

E0752

`Atomic` cannot be used inside `#Transact`

What

`Atomic` cannot be used inside `#Transact`

Why

`Shared<T>` is the lock-guarded family for multi-value transactions; `Atomic<T>` is one lock-free scalar and has no transaction commit semantics

Fix

Move the atomic operation outside `#Transact`, or use `Shared<T>` when several values must commit together

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0752: tests/ui/atomic_inside_transact.stderr.
